Answer: B
Reason: The initial chest X-ray demonstrates mild patchy increased interstitial markings at the lung bases with stable cardiomegaly, while the second X-ray shows progression to diffuse patchy bilateral airspace opacities. This radiographic evolution from subtle interstitial changes to widespread bilateral opacities is characteristic of viral pneumonia, specifically supporting a diagnosis of COVID-19 pneumonia over bacterial causes or heart failure.
